summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the publication of its tenth annual Responsible Mining Report and fifth annual Climate Strategy Report. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine ESG report and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
